gbm_population_evidence.quote: Pathological evidence of newly diagnosed glioblastoma according to WHO classification criteria

candidate_evidence.quote: [DEVICE] Radiofrequency electromagnetic field treatment (other names: mEHT, capacitive hyperthermia, electrohyperthermia): Radiofrequency electromagnetic field treatment using a carrier frequency of 13.56 MHz
Radiochemotherapy (RCT) and maintenance chemotherapy (CT) according to Stupp et al. 2005 combined with radiofrequency electromagnetic field treatment.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Pathological evidence of newly diagnosed glioblastoma according to WHO classification criteria

role_evidence.quote: followed by RCT (60 Gy over six weeks) with concomitant CT (temozolomide 75mg/m2) on all days, followed by maintenance CT (temozolomide150-200 mg/m2) on d1-5 for six cycles every 28 days.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent; Stupp standard of care

source_quote.quote: MGMT-promotor methylated patients must have refused therapy according to the CeTeG/NOA-09 protocol (+ Lomustin)

coder_notes: Device trial (amplitude-modulated RF electromagnetic field / modulated electrohyperthermia) added to Stupp chemoradiation; registered phase NA. Only drug is temozolomide as standard backbone; no pharmacological candidate, exclusion coded excluded_intervention_type (device). MGMT criterion is conditional (methylated patients eligible only if they refused CeTeG/lomustine), not a strict MGMT status requirement; coded eligibility for transparency, adjudicator may prefer to drop it.
